test_debris_removed.what_it_is: Leftover image-compression output from a previous run of tests/Unit/MediaHelperTest.php. Test output, not test source.
test_debris_removed.action_taken: Directory deleted once during Phase 0.14. NOT a fix.
test_debris_removed.why_not_a_fix: MediaHelperTest.php:23 passes the relative fixed path 'tests/compressed' into MediaHelper::compressUploadedImage(), which calls mkdir() without an existence guard. The directory is recreated on every run, so deleting it suppresses the warning for that run only. Verified: the run after deletion reported 1 warning again.
test_debris_removed.additional_finding: The same test's only assertion is assertTrue($result['is_compressed'] || !$result['is_compressed']) - a tautology that cannot fail, so the test provides no real coverage.
test_debris_removed.impact: No production impact. The suite is green either way, but the output is misleading because a green test is reported as a warning.
test_debris_removed.suite_result_note: The suite reports 558 passed / 0 warnings on a clean working tree and 557 passed / 1 warning on a repeat run. Both are correct; the difference is this test only.
